src_text: Ayabwenerete gokorwa ritangani chingaki chimobasekano.Okwegerigwa kwa bosa na St.John Ambulance and Kenya Red cross.
tgt_text: Basic first aid saves lives during disasters. Free training is available through St. John Ambulance and Kenya Red Cross.

src_text: Emesabeka no nigo ere omochando omonene ase abanto bare noborema.Abanto benyomba eyemo nere buya koroberia igoro yenchera yogwekonya baranyare goetera nyuma yomobasekano oyio.
tgt_text: Disasters disproportionately affect people with disabilities. Families should plan accessible evacuation routes in advance.

src_text: Abatigari bemebasekano chingaki chinyinge nigo bakweiranana.Obotebereria na obokonyi bwa bosa mboreo ase chinyagitari chieserikari na goetera ebiombe biria bitari bieserikari(NGOs).
tgt_text: Survivors of disasters often face trauma. Free counseling is available at government health centers and through NGOs.

src_text: Baria banyorirwe nomochando bweguragura enene nabo bakonyora endagera korwa eserikari.Karwe amang'ana igoro yabanto bare nchara gochia eserikari ensemo ya baria batenenerete ogokonya igoro yokorwa obokonyi chingaki chieguragura enene.
tgt_text: Drought-affected families can access government relief food. Report hunger cases to the National Drought Management Authority.

src_text: Chinka nechisukuru chire chingongo chiriachibwate rinaga rinene ria emechando goika chitwatre oborendi bore igoro konua emetengecho nee chikoba
tgt_text: Homes and schools in disaster-prone areas should meet safety standards to withstand floods, earthquakes, and storms.

src_text: Counties chibegete chinsemo chio obotamero bera ange nase ayie beka ebinto bio'bokonyi ang'e.
tgt_text: Counties have designated evacuation centers. Locate your nearest shelter and keep emergency kits ready.

src_text: Nyuma yetoigo,chisoko chia amache nabo chirasareke tumia chitetere chia ogosibia amache ose oberie.
tgt_text: After floods, water sources may be contaminated. Use water purification tablets or boil water before drinking.

src_text: Erike nomoroberio oria okorwa ogokurera igoro bwabsemi berire erio konyora ogosemia kwa beene igoro yembura eneene egocha netoigo ase ekenyoro kiao.
tgt_text: Subscribe to SMS alerts from the Meteorological Department to receive real-time flood warnings in your area.

src_text: Chikomiti chi nka ase okomanyania na kobwaterana igoro yobokonyi na kobga obokonyi chinaki chiomobasekano.Erwe gokomora emeremo yokwerwa.
tgt_text: Local committees help coordinate rescue efforts and resource distribution during emergencies. Volunteer with your village committee.

src_text: Enhera etabwenereti buna etugo ekwete egotindekwa nenchera eyemo yogwateka kwendwari.Bwatita ayarikire korwa baria bakoraa obochenu ekero endwari yatekire.
tgt_text: Improper handling of corpses risks disease outbreaks. Follow Textlines from health authorities during mass fatalities.

src_text: Etugo negento iiengencho ase endangera.Manyia abanyagitari betugo yetugo eria ere ase obokong'u kobwenia nagochirageria amo nobokonyi boganeirie.
tgt_text: Livestock are critical for livelihoods. Report distressed animals to veterinary officers for feed and medical support.

src_text: Tumia chitoci ase oborabu erio gotanga ogwateka kwomorero ekero esitima etaiyo.Manyia abanto besitima igoro yemerande yesitima eyio egwete inse.
tgt_text: Use flashlights instead of candles to prevent fires during blackouts. Report downed power lines to Kenya Power.

src_text: Chikampani nchibwenerete koba nomoroberio bwokogenderera,koba nebinto buna chichenereta chiomorero,na gosimia abakori emerebo baye igoro yemebasekano.
tgt_text: Companies should have continuity plans, backup generators, and employee safety training for emergencies.

src_text: Abanto baria baseretigwe korwa ase bare gokora emeremo ekero kieminano yechikura chibopresidenti omwaka 2007/2008 na korenta egegi embe yebiama biegesiasa nebisaku, igo ere obwororo ase bare konyorwa namarwaire. Bakonye konyora amache amaya, chichoo, namariogo aaria chikambi chiabo.
tgt_text: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) are vulnerable to diseases. Ensure clean water, sanitation, and medical supplies in camps.

src_text: Gotumia echenereta etarosirie buya namakanika esambe ediseli gose epetiroli buya ekero okoyetumia konyora chunguru chiesuitima nigo egosokia erioki ribabwate esumu ekero kwayeeyanire yaba esumu ase omobere oo. Okia echenereta are korwa ase emerangu nechitirisa erioki tirisoa nyoma.
tgt_text: Improper generator use causes carbon monoxide poisoning. Operate generators outdoors and away from windows.

src_text: Tabanto begeirie bokwerwa nigo bagokonya ekero kiemesekano. Erike byuna oyomo obo nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) gose ecomiti eria yanka eusikaine nemeremo eyio.
tgt_text: Trained volunteers assist in rescue operations. Register with Kenya Red Cross or local disaster committees.

src_text: Ekero kiechando emetambe buna omogaso gose embura enyinge, gacha endagera ase okoyiomia, koyebeka omonyo, goge koyesiba ime yebibekerero embeo etari gosoa ime koyerenda tegunda.
tgt_text: During prolonged disasters, preserve food by drying, salting, or using airtight containers to avoid spoilage.

src_text: Amangana oborimo nigo akogesa obororo. Nyora amangana korwa aase aronge buna eserikari amo nabariki na abamanyi amangana bokwegenwa.
tgt_text: Rumors worsen panic. Rely on official updates from government agencies and verified media outlets.

src_text: Chingiti ching'enda'nse origia chire obomenyo chinka chiaito ekero chietoigo. Tumia etochi botuko na erende gotatacha inse namagoro amasa aotabegeti ebiato.
tgt_text: Snakes seek shelter in homes during floods. Use torches at night and avoid walking barefoot.

src_text: Chifamiri chiria chitari kwenyara gose chintaka mbwango konyorwa nemechando, tema goikera ogokonya gweserikari goetera omoroberio (o'cash aid) ekero kiemechando goetera esimi yao.
tgt_text: Vulnerable families can access government cash aid during disasters via mobile money platforms.

src_text: Tiga koirorera kwoagacha ase riroba rikoanyoka. Eserikari nkorwa ere emegondo emao ase oyio oo ase chifamilia chianyorirwe nomochando oyio.
tgt_text: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.

src_text: Amasomo abosa igoro yokwerenda ekero kiomorero nareo ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka.
tgt_text: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.

src_text: Nere buya ase abaremi gosimeka ebimeri bikoremereria omogaso omnene amo nenchera yokogacha na gotumia buya amache na gotanga konyorwa gose gokeania konyorwa nemechando eyio .
tgt_text: Farmers should adopt drought-resistant crops and water conservation techniques to mitigate climate shocks.

src_text: Egera koacha chinyomba ogtumia ebinto bigotoka inka ase bari baseretigwe korwa aase bare abwo nyuma.
tgt_text: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.

src_text: Tema komanya buna obwoba gose ogwechanda kwa abanto banyorirwe nomobasekano erio kobakonya korwania obwoba obwo goetera obosemia bwebirengererio na kobasira nchera ende yonsi erio banyare gotenenana kogenderera.
tgt_text: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.

src_text: Rora ng'a omotungi bwegasi yokorugera mbuya egachiire na aase agiya are nerigaba riembeo gosoa ime, na rigereria kera chingaki komanya gose egasi nkominchoria ere korwa omotungi oyesokie bwango buna enchera eyemo yogotanga emebasekano.
tgt_text: Ensure LPG cylinders are stored in well-ventilated areas and check for leaks regularly.

src_text: Abanto abagotu mbaganetie enchera yabeene kobatamia korwa emebasekano. Beka abatenereri babo amo nase oraibaire kobera motwe yokobatania korwa omobasekano.
tgt_text: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.

src_text: Chikemiko naguta nere buya kogachwa are korwa chinka na ase engencho ebwenerete eri ogotanga ogwateka kwemerero na ogosaria amasingira.
tgt_text: Chemicals and fuels should be stored away from homes to prevent fires and environmental contamination.

src_text: Abanto basirete nnabo barabwatigwe goetera ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) amo nabariki amangana na komanyia abanto amang'ana.
tgt_text: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.

src_text: Chiumbu nigo chikoiborerana ase amache atereime. Tumia chineti chiebitanda korara na manyia abanyagitari igoro yokoromwa nechiumbu na buna abanto barwarete.
tgt_text: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes. Use bed nets and report mosquito infestations to health authorities.

src_text: Nere buya ebinyoro kobeka chinguri chiabo ase okorema ebisima ebinene bia abanto abange nomoroberion bwogotacha amache erio koba namache aisaine chingaki chieguragura.
tgt_text: Communities should invest in boreholes and rainwater harvesting to ensure water access during droughts.

src_text: Amachiko aKenya igoro yobokoreri ekero kia omobasekano nkoenekia are ng'a okobeaterana nekomoti yemebasekano. Manya aboronge bwao neki eserikari ebwenerete kogokorera.
tgt_text: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.

src_text: Enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195 inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi koreng'ana na eki ore.
tgt_text: The national helpline 1195 is available at all times to provide immediate assistance to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.

src_text: Eminano gose ogokurarana gati yomosacha nomokungu oye mara aanga nigo gokogenderera kogesekana na koba boke ng'orang'ora. Mbuya komanya ayio bwango na kwegeria abakoreri baria bare motwe gokonya ase okobaikera na kobakonya ebirengererio na kobaraa gochia nyagitari ase kobwenigwa.
tgt_text: Intimate partner violence often escalates gradually. Early recognition and training for frontline professionals support prevention and safe referrals.

src_text: Omoroberio oo aye omonyene kwerenda ngokonya ore kwebanga chingaki chiokong'u ase okomanya boronge ase ogotamera gochia na buna okwerenda.
tgt_text: Personal safety plans help individuals prepare for dangerous situations by identifying safe locations and strategies for protection.

src_text: Ebokundi biogosira ase ebinyoro nigo bigokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe ase enchera yokobaa aase bakobera atari namochando onde bwonsi goetera abakonyi babo bokwerwa begeirie buya, kobasira goetera ebinto bike bike bikobakonya, na kobwaterana gochia ase baranyare konyora obokonyi ao ao, oborendi bwaigoro nobobisi bwabo.
tgt_text: Community support networks assist survivors by providing safe spaces, trained volunteers, empowerment programs, and coordinated referrals while prioritizing safety and confidentiality.

src_text: Koba namachiko ase abanto bagokora emeremo na kobaegeria igor yoboronge bwa mwanyabanto ngokonya ere gokorerwa bobe kebwanchani egekogera kera omokori emeremo amanyete buya nga ogokora eke gose keria aya naria naro aramonyore, chinchera omonto akomanyeria abane igoro yayio, obotuki, amo nemeroberio yokomosira korengna nerichiko riense.
tgt_text: Workplace policies and training prevent sexual harassment by establishing clear definitions, reporting channels, investigations, and support services based on national legal frameworks.

src_text: Nebwenerete nga ebitengo bionsi bire bikorenda abana gtanga na abana gotibonwa na bosomba bonde bwonsi goetera okobaa ogokonya gwa kera engencho.
tgt_text: Child protection systems must prevent sexual abuse and exploitation and provide full support for affected children.

src_text: Abakori emeremo bobochenu mbaganeirie amaorokererio abeene ase ogokonya barwaire babo komanya emechando nagekong'ia koyerwania, kobeka amo obosaiti , kobeka eripoti as ebitabu, na na okobwatera kobatoma gochia baranyore obokonyi bwa beene.
tgt_text: Healthcare workers require specialized training in trauma-informed care, evidence collection, mandatory reporting, and coordinated referrals for survivors.

src_text: Aase agiya neyomba yokomenya nensemo eyemo yoborendi ase baria bakoreirwe bobe nabana babo.
tgt_text: Safe houses and shelters offer secure temporary accommodation for survivors and their children.

src_text: Goetera obokonyi bwedichitari nkonyarekana ere gosioria baria bagokorera bobe abande goetera eintaneti. Amachiko nkorenda are abanto tobakorerwa bobe goetera eintaneti na kobakonya korenda chisimi nechikombiuta chiabo neintaneti korwa ebibago, korwa eripoti yokogoserwa, na gotinyia amangana aria akogechia.
tgt_text: Digital spaces can expose individuals to online abuse. Laws criminalize cyberviolence and support services help survivors secure devices, report incidents, and remove harmful content.

src_text: Renta abasacha nabura amo ase emeroberio yogosegeta oboamate obuya ase abanto na orokereria buna ogotareng'anana kwa banto ase engencho yebimira ere bobe.
tgt_text: Engaging men and boys in prevention programs promotes healthy relationships and challenges harmful gender norms.

src_text: Ogokonya abanto kemachiko nigo korengete korora nga goikera ekeene goeera gokonywa bosa otari korwa kende gose ogoaka pesa inke igo omogambi bwebina gokogambera kotini.
tgt_text: Legal aid services ensure survivors access justice through free or subsidized representation.

src_text: Chisukuru razima chiikeranie emeroberio gotanga gokorerwa bobe kobasuguma gose kobagechi, kobarwania ngose komiga oboronge bwabo ase engencho bare abagongeru ase chisukuru.
tgt_text: Educational institutions must implement prevention programs that address harassment, assault, and exploitation in learning environments.

src_text: Obosaria bwobogoko nigo bokomiga okwenyara nogwetenenera gwechibesa. Ebiombe baria bionsi bigokora nechibesa nere buya asebire komanya bwango emechando ere motwe na buna baranyare gokonya baria bakogachera chibesa chiabo.
tgt_text: Economic abuse limits financial independence. Financial institutions should recognize warning signs and support affected customers.

src_text: Enchera yokobetereria gose koira abanto ase egete ase engencho yokobaonia ase ebiasara biobwanchani konyora chibesa okomocha okobe mono. Amachiko yense nkorwa are egesusuro ekerito na gokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe.
tgt_text: Human trafficking for sexual exploitation is a serious crime. National laws provide strong penalties and survivor protections.

src_text: Amasakara abwate amaborio na buna abanto bakoiraneria ebigokonya korora na komanya buna abanto baria bare ase ekonyarekana gokorerwa bobe gose kogenderera gokorerwa bobe erio gokonya kobeka emeroberio yogotanga ebwenerete.
tgt_text: Risk assessment tools help identify individuals at high risk of experiencing or perpetrating violence to enable targeted interventions.

src_text: Emeroberio yokobakonya baria bakoreirwe bobe nigo ekoimokereria igoro oborendi, amasikani, obobisi, nobosibore bwomonto korwa ebirengerio biaye neko aganeti gokorerwa.
tgt_text: Survivor-centered approaches uphold safety, dignity, and autonomy in all decisions about reporting and service use.

src_text: Chingaki chiemebasekano gose obokongu nigo chikogesa ribaga abanto gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare naya ekero abeire neganeirie chinchera chigotanga abanto gokorerwa bobe chaiabeene na emeroberio buna baranyare gokonywa.
tgt_text: Emergency settings heighten gender-based violence risks and require specialized prevention and response planning.

src_text: Amangana aria arikire amaikeranu buna chiripoti chiabasikari, chianyagitari na NGOs chikworokia buna abanto bagokorerwa bobe erio gokonya korosia amachiko nemeroberio yokobakonya.
tgt_text: Reliable data systems track violence trends and service use to inform evidence-based policies and programs.

src_text: Omoroberio bwoboamo obangire buya komanyia na gosomia abanto korengete gosegeta abanto goonchoreria na kwanga gokorera abanto bande bobe na korwa eripoti igoro ya baria bakoreirwe bobe otarikonyorwa, amo noboriki na komanyia abanto amang'ana goetera chiredio na amagaseti ase enchewra etari koeneria gokwanrera obobe bwogokorera aband bobe.
tgt_text: Strategic communication campaigns promote non-violent norms and responsible media coverage of gender-based violence.

src_text: Abanto abaremaru nigo bagokorerwa bobe kobua abanto bande. Ogokonywa kobarengete goika goikeranie buna bagoikerwa nokogania kwabo ase bonsi.
tgt_text: Persons with disabilities face higher risks of violence. Services must meet accessibility needs and provide inclusive support.

src_text: Chichera goika chitange ogokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki oro na korwa egusuro korengana nokomocha kwabamochi.
tgt_text: Correctional facilities must prevent sexual violence and respond effectively to any incidents.

src_text: Ogokorerwa bobe goetra eintaneti neganetie oborendi bwegedichitari goetera ogosomia nenchera engiya yokorika na kogacha amang'ana ase bari bakoreire bobe.
tgt_text: Technology-facilitated abuse requires digital security training and documentation skills for affected individuals.

src_text: Oborendi goetera emeroberio yebinyoro goetra okoreta abarai nebiombe amo korora nga abanto bonsi mbuya bare kera ase bare.
tgt_text: Community-based prevention programs mobilize local leaders and groups to create safer environments.

src_text: Amasomo okorigia chisemi chinyia, kobanga emeroberio na korosia amachiko goetera obomanyi obwo koba nechinguru gotanga gokorerwa bobe.
tgt_text: Research strengthens program design and policy by generating evidence on effective prevention and response strategies.

src_text: Obakungu bagokora siasa nigo bagokorerwa bobe korengete gokeania esiasa yabo gochia ase abasqacha. Amachiko obochori nkorenda are abarigia chikura nabaaki chikura korwa gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare.
tgt_text: Women in politics face violence aimed at limiting participation. Electoral laws protect candidates and voters from gender-based harm.

src_text: Ase abanto bakobwenerigwa goikbapime ekerengo omonto okoreire bobe na korwa obobwenia boisaine naende obuya.
tgt_text: Healthcare facilities must screen for violence and provide safe and comprehensive responses for survivors.

src_text: Abarai bechirori chikobogori abanto goika chitange ebikoru biokogosereria goetera ogosomia bakori emeremo babo na korwa egesusuro ase abamochi.
tgt_text: Public transport systems must address harassment through staff training and appropriate response measures.

src_text: Abakungu bagokora emeremo ase oboremi nigo bare ase okonyorwa nemechando yabeene. Ebiombe bioboremi nere buya bitabe amachiko yogotanga nenchera yokorwa chiripoti.
tgt_text: Women in agriculture face distinct risks. Cooperatives should adopt prevention policies and reporting options.

src_text: Abanto bamenyete chirandi mabaganetie okobwaterana newbinyoro erio gokeania chiburaburu.
tgt_text: High-density informal settlements require community-led safety efforts to reduce violence.

src_text: Chidini ngosegeta chire buna ebinyoro bikorosia amachiko ekemira. Gosomia barai bechidini nigo egokonya gosegeta ababwatai babo korenda amasingira.
tgt_text: Religious institutions influence community norms. Clergy training and counseling support safe and equitable environments.

src_text: Emeroberio yechigori goika ekonye gotanga ebikoru bikogosereri agose bikogechi, gose bikorasimisa omonto gosoa na chinchera chiokoripoti ayio.
tgt_text: Sports programs must prevent harassment, abuse, and hazing through clear boundaries and reporting procedures.

src_text: Emeremo yoborubi chinswe yaretire obwoba bwokorerwa bobe na koriananigwa. Gokongia oborendi aaria ase chinswe chigoikerigwa korwa obwato ngosira ere oborendi bwabokori emeremo.
tgt_text: Fishing industry environments pose risks of exploitation. Safety improvements at docks support worker protection.

src_text: Okorema amadini nigo koganetie amachiko amaikeranu noborendi gotanga okorera abande bobe, kogechi gose gochaya nakobarianania .
tgt_text: Mining areas require strict policies and safety measures to prevent harassment and exploitation.

src_text: Chichiro goika chibe nemeroberio egokonya abanyabiasara korwa okwemurangania kwabo gotanga gokorerwa bobe, kiogechigwa, kogosererigwa gose kobetererigwa gkorwa chibesa.
tgt_text: Market environments must establish reporting systems and committees to prevent harassment and extortion.

src_text: Aase abanto bamenyete na mono baria bare noborema chinchera chiokobarenda chingiya nchiganeirie na kobakonya goikera chisemi chioboronge na buna baranyare goteba ekero bakoreirwe bobe.
tgt_text: Residential facilities for persons with disabilities require strong safeguards and accessible education on rights and reporting.

src_text: Aaria chiofisi chieserikari ase abanto bagokorera emeremo goika chitange ogokorerwa bobe, kobabetereria gose kobagosereria oetera okobasomia, obotenereri, nechinchera chiokorwa okwemurangania kwabo.
tgt_text: Government workplaces must maintain zero tolerance for harassment through training, accountability, and independent reporting systems.

src_text: Abana mbare ase hatari goetera eintaneti. Abaibori goika bamongere buna abana babo bagotumia eintaneti, batabge na komanyia abana babo chinchera chingiya chibaretere emechando.
tgt_text: Children face online risks. Parents should monitor use, apply controls, and teach safe behavior.

src_text: Ogosoi abana ase ebinto bitancheiri, kobatamia gose kobabisa erio kobatumia ase chinchera chitabwenereti neringa rinene riokogosia. Ebinyoro goika birwe amang'ana igiro yebinto bare nechitangutangu ase abagambi gose abasikari.
tgt_text: Child trafficking remains a major threat. Communities should report suspicious activity to authorities.

src_text: Chisukuru goika chiikerania amachiko oborendi, gokorera abana abande bobe, na korwa obosemia erio korenda abana buya.
tgt_text: Schools must implement protection policies, anti-bullying systems, and counseling services to safeguard learners.

src_text: Abaibori abarendi babana barigererigwa buya bataraegwa abana korenda erio korenda nga abana baria abake batanyare kwerenda.
tgt_text: Foster caregivers must be vetted to ensure safe environments for vulnerable children.

src_text: Abana bare ase ogochandeka bwebirengererio mbagabeti ogokonywa kobakonya gokinania omochando oyio bosa goetera chinkwana nomonyagitari konyora chinguru chiogokinana nebirengererio.
tgt_text: Children experiencing trauma need psychological support available through free counseling services.

src_text: Abana baria banarete obogima bwokobera ebisona ase chitaoni mbaganetie ase bakorara, chisemi, nemeroberio yokobairania chinka chiabo ase oborendi namagenderero.
tgt_text: Street-connected children require shelters, education, and reintegration programs for safety and development.

src_text: Obosomba bwabana mamincha yerichiko. Karwe eripoti igoro yabana bare ase emeremo eranyare kobaretera emechando gochia chiofisi chitenererete obokori emeremo gose goaka esimi 0800220444.
tgt_text: Child labor is illegal. Report hazardous child work to the Labour Department or call 0800220444.

src_text: Abana abwo bare ase okoariganigwa gotamigwa mamincha yerichiko neganeirie konyora obokonyi mwachiko bosa goetera ofisi yomoteneneri bwobosoi ebina (ODPP).
tgt_text: Children involved in legal processes should receive specialized legal aid through the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

src_text: Nere buya abana kwegera buna baranyare korenda amangana abo arikire are ase eintaneti na komanyia oyo begenete igoro yechitang'utang'u.
tgt_text: Children should learn to protect personal information online and report suspicious interactions to trusted adults.

src_text: Chiburaburu chiekenyomba nigo chikoumisa gose gosaria abana. Karwe amangana igoro yaya gochia abagambi gose chiofosi chieserikari chirendete abana.
tgt_text: Domestic violence harms children. Report incidents to local authorities or child helplines.

src_text: Eserikari na NGOs ngokonya chire abana chitankana ase okobakonya ase chinchera ao ao chiengencho. Buna okogora abana ase enchera yamachiko gochia abaibiri bakabere na kobabwatia kemachiko komanya ng'a mbuya barendete abana abwo.
tgt_text: Government and NGOs support orphaned children with essential services. Adoption and foster care follow legal guidelines.

src_text: Kera omwana nare noboronge bwokonyora chisemi, obobwenia, na oborendi. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yotaikeranigwa kwayio.
tgt_text: Every child has rights to education, healthcare, and protection. Communities must report violations.

src_text: Ogokorera abande bobe nigo gokoreta ogochandeka kwebirengererio, ogoichania goika gotiga amasomo. Chisukuru nere buya kobeka amachiko amakong'u gotanga ogokorera abande bobe na korwa obosemia ase abana baria bakoreirwe bobe.
tgt_text: Bullying leads to depression and school dropouts. Schools must enforce strict anti-bullying policies and provide counseling for affected children.

src_text: Ekero kiemebasekano buna (etoigo, nopgwateka kwemerero), abana nabwo bagochandeka mono ekiagera batari naguru chigokonya. Rora ng'a batammigwe gose korusigwa aroro buya na bae ogokonywa kwebirengererio goetra okobakwanera.
tgt_text: In disasters (floods, fires), children are most vulnerable. Ensure they are evacuated safely and receive psychosocial support.

src_text: Abana bare noborema nigo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe. Rora nga abana bonsi ba kera engencho banyorire chisemi na buna baranyare komanyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe ase oborendi bwabo.
tgt_text: Children with disabilities face higher risks of abuse. Ensure inclusive education and accessible reporting mechanisms for their protection.

src_text: Nere buya ebinyoro koba nechikomiti igoro yoborendi bwa abana chikomongera na koripoti buna abana kogorerwa bobe, gokora emeremo yabo ase ase okobwaterana nebiombe bieserikari.
tgt_text: Local communities should establish child protection committees to monitor and report abuse cases, working closely with government agencies.

src_text: Chipori stesheni nchire negetengo kiabeen kegosugurikia buna abana bakomecherwa buna ogoakwa, ogotibongwa, obosomba, okoiba gose gokengania abana ase enchera chiobosani nabana na erendete obobisi bwabana. Karwe eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi.
tgt_text: The Kenya Police have specialized desks to handle child-related cases with sensitivity and confidentiality. Report cases at any police station.

src_text: Ogotarenda gose koa omwana ebinto atagete nigo ekogocha ogokina na okogenderera kwomwana. Abaibori nabarendi babana goika bae abana babo ebi bakonyara, buna obwanchani, noborendi gotanga mechando yebirengererio nogochandeka ase engaki entambe.
tgt_text: Neglect harms a child's development. Parents and guardians must provide basic needs, love, and security to prevent long-term trauma.

src_text: Abana ba baria batamete chisegi korwa sobo igo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe gokenganigwa gose koibwa. Ebiombe bikorwanerera oboronge bwekemwanyabanto bieserikari nkorwa bire obomenyo obuya nechisemi aaria ase chikambi.
tgt_text: Refugee children are vulnerable to abuse and trafficking. Humanitarian agencies provide safe shelters and education in camps.

src_text: Abanto bande mbagenderete gokora ebienyechi buna ogekeba abanyaroka ebio bire mamincha noboronge bwa abana. Karwe eripoti yamang'ana ayio gochia ase abambi otari konyorwa.
tgt_text: Some communities still practice harmful traditions involving children. Report such cases to authorities immediately.

src_text: Oboreri obuya nigo bogokeania abana gokorerwa bobe. Soa gose kabe oyomo ase omoroberio bweserikari gosomigwa chinchera buna oranyare korenda abana.
tgt_text: Positive parenting reduces abuse risks. Attend government-sponsored parenting programs to learn child protection strategies.

src_text: Ebina birengete abana goika ebina biabo bigamberwe ase chikoti chiabeene korora ng'a biagendiigwe buya birendete gotatubania obongo naende korwa obobe bwabete.
tgt_text: Children involved in legal matters should go through specialized courts to ensure fair and trauma-sensitive proceedings.

src_text: Abana abake konywa amarwa nigo gokogesa obosaria nemechando ya afia. Nere buya chisukuru nabaibori basomie abana igoro yemachando yokonywa amarwa.
tgt_text: Underage drug use leads to crime and health issues. Schools and parents should educate children on substance abuse dangers.

src_text: Aka esimi 116 (Obokonyi ase Abana) gose 999 (Emebasekano) komnyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe kwomwana, ogoserigwa gose okwangwa, gose koba ase obosomba erio onyore ogokonya kegima.
tgt_text: Dial 116 (Child Helpline) or 999 (Emergency) to report child abuse, neglect, or exploitation for immediate assistance.

src_text: Abana bare chinsemo chiria buna Kenya ya Irianyi nigo ere raisi ase bare koibwa na gosoigwa ase ebiombe biobokebago. Ebiombe bieserikari goika birwe birigerie ayio ase okobarenda.
tgt_text: Children in areas like Northern Kenya face abduction and recruitment into armed groups. Security agencies must prioritize their safety.

src_text: nabo ekonyarekana nga ebiband biabana bibwe gokorera obongainereria. Abaibori brende buya chisatificate chiokoiborwa chia abana babo no komongera buna chibesa chigosao chisimi chiabo.
tgt_text: Children's identities can be stolen for fraud. Parents should safeguard birth certificates and monitor credit reports.

src_text: Baria bakoreirwe bobe gose gotibongwa nere buya konyora obokonyi bwobobwenia, kemachiko, anakebirengererio. Chisenta chiegeirie gokora emeremo eyio nkorwa chire obokonyi bwa bosa Kenya engima.
tgt_text: Victims of sexual abuse need medical, legal, and psychological support. Specialized centers offer free services nationwide.

src_text: Abana abange nigo bkogwa nagokwera ime yechinsemo chiamache. Abaibiri goika barande abana babio ekero bare ange nase aria agoakerwa ontimbu, chindoche, amo nechinsoko.
tgt_text: Many children drown in open water sources. Parents should supervise kids near pools, rivers, and wells.

src_text: Chikanisa nemesikiti goika bakongori abakori emeremo babo na goikerania amachiko agotanga gokorera abana bobe imse yechinyomba chiikanisa gose emesikiti.
tgt_text: Churches and mosques must vet staff and implement policies to prevent child abuse within their facilities.

src_text: Abariki na baria bagotangasa amang'ana goika barende gotanga nga amangana agosaria abana ase ogotatora amarieta abo nase barwete ekero bakomanyia amangan buna abana bagokorerwa bobe.
tgt_text: Media should avoid exposing children to harmful content and respect their privacy when reporting on abuse cases.

src_text: Ebibago nigo bigotumia ribaga riabana gotenyara ase ogosaberera. Manyia abasikari kobakonya na kobarongei.
tgt_text: Criminal gangs exploit children for begging. Report such cases to the police for rescue and rehabilitation.

src_text: Rora nga chirori chisukuru nchuibwate chirensesi buya nomotereba buya achoretwe korenga gotanga emebasekano na koibwa kwa abana.
tgt_text: Ensure school vans are properly licensed and drivers vetted to prevent accidents and kidnappings.

src_text: Ebiobago biria bigosaria amongo abanto na kobaira obokebago bwokotuta chipomu nigo nigo birengete abana baria batari kwenyara gose korwa emchie emetaka . Abanto gioka barwe eripoti igoro yebinto bare nechitang'utang'u nabirobio gose okorikwa gosoa obokebago obwo.
tgt_text: Extremist groups target vulnerable children. Communities should report suspicious recruitment activities.

src_text: Somia abana chinhera chiokwerenda nomorero na rora ng'a chinka chibwate egento keria gekomanya ekero erioki rireo erio gokonya gotanga emerero gwateka.
tgt_text: Teach children fire safety measures and ensure homes have working smoke detectors to prevent tragedies.

src_text: Chigosori chieintaneti nigo chigosuguma abana ang'e gochia ase ebibago biabo. Abaibori goika bamongere chingaki abana bakorrigereria chigosori na ase chinsa gete.
tgt_text: Online games can expose children to predators. Parents should monitor gaming interactions and set time limits.

src_text: Chifamiri goika chisangie abana babo amo koroberia buna baranyare gotange omorero tibwateka sobo na ekero bwatekire ase bagotamera gochia nechinamba chiesimi barangerie konyora ogokonya.
tgt_text: Families should include children in disaster drills and ensure they know emergency contacts.

src_text: Abanyabiasara goika barende tibarika abana buna abkori emeremo yabo korende basire emeroberio yogokonya ng'a bachire esukuru gosoma.
tgt_text: Businesses must avoid employing children and support initiatives for their education instead.

src_text: Aaria ase abanto bagosomera gokora chogosori goika babe namachiko agotanga gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore gose ogotabatabwa ase abanyagosori abasae.
tgt_text: Sports academies must have policies against physical and sexual abuse of young athletes.

src_text: Baria bakoroberria emeyega nere buya kobekaase abana basirete bakobekwa negento abaibiri basireriigwe nabana babo babwenerete gokora ekero kiesangerekano emenene.
tgt_text: Event organizers should provide child-safe spaces and lost-child protocols during large gatherings.

src_text: Aase abanto bakorwa isiko (abatari) bagotarera chingaki chinyinge nigo akoba aase abana bagokorigwa egasi gose gotibongi. Karwe eripoti gochia baria batenenerete obotari.
tgt_text: Tourist hotspots sometimes exploit children for labor or sex. Report such cases to the Tourism Regulatory Authority.

src_text: machiko a Kenya akongiigwe erio korenda abana baria batari konyara kwerenda gose korwa emechie emetaka erio korenda oboronge bwa abana. Kabe gokomanyigwa igoro yamaonchorerio arengete ebiombe biabana.
tgt_text: Kenya's laws are evolving to better protect children's rights. Stay informed on legal changes affecting child welfare.

src_text: Abaamate,abarimu, na abairi goika bakwenere ringana igoro yabana gokorerwa bobe erio korora ng'a abana tibari ase hatari yogokorerwa bobe.
tgt_text: Neighbors, teachers, and relatives must speak up against child abuse to create safer environments for children.

src_text: Oboibi bwechiombe nabo botigarete koba omochando aaria chinsemo chiobotugi. Nere buya ebinyoro koba nemeroberio yobomongeri, basambererie chiombe chiabo chinamba, na korwa eripoti igoro yamangana bare nechitangutangu naro.
tgt_text: Livestock theft remains a challenge in pastoralist regions. Communities should form watch programs, brand animals, and report suspicious activities.

src_text: Ogokeana kwamache chingaki chieguragura nigo ekorenta asara Nere buya abaremi kwegera gotacha na kogacha amache ase okorema chingoro, kogora ebibuyu ebinene, koagacha chitangi chia'mahe inse yeriraba.
tgt_text: Water scarcity during droughts causes losses. Farmers should adopt water harvesting methods such as dams, pans, and subsurface storage.

src_text: Gotanga okoererania etugo korwa ensemo eyemo gochia eyende nigo egotana okwambokerana kwamarwaire yetugo nabanto. Beta chiombe esindani yoborwaire bwomonwa namagoro, chiombe chikorwaa gochia aria chichanche, renda chingiti chiorosana tichiika ange, na karwe eripoti ioro yetugo erwarete otrikonyorwa. Tindeka etugo eri yakure inse kabisa.
tgt_text: Biosecurity prevents disease outbreaks. Disinfect footbaths, quarantine new animals, control wildlife access, and report sick animals promptly. Proper carcass disposal is essential.

src_text: Omoreoberio o'Kenya komanya etugo, na komanya ase yarwete ngosambereria ore chiombe chinamba gose gochikera chinamba ase amato buna enchera yogotanga oboibi.
tgt_text: The Kenya Livestock Identification and Traceability System assigns herd numbers and ear tags to support theft prevention and disease control.

src_text: Ogoitwa gwetugo nechingiti chiorosana buna endagera yabo nigo gokoreta asara ase omoremi. Nere buya abaremi koagacha gose kogitera etugo yabo buya gotanga chingiti chiorosana goikera etugo yabo na koyeita bua endagera yabo. Ogoakanwa ase baria etugo yabo yaitetwe nechingiti chiorosana nereo ase baria bagitere etugo yabo buya.
tgt_text: Wildlife predation causes losses. Farmers should construct predator-proof enclosures and use guard animals. Compensation is available for verified cases.

src_text: Ensuarence erendete abaremi bobotugi nereo ekero rioka yamanyakinire nga omobaso omonene gose etoigo gose ogwateka kwendwari etare konyarekana ekorenda abatugi gotera ebimoreki bieintenet igoro aa ase rire bokorenga ekerengo omochando ore gokonys chiinsuarence komanya nechibesa irenga bagoakana omoremi.
tgt_text: Index-based livestock insurance protects pastoralists from drought losses using satellite data triggers.

src_text: Okoererania gwetugo gotancheirie nigo kogotaria amarwaire. Nere buya abaremi basabe rirube rikobanchera goetia etugo korwa aa gochia aari na kobwatia amachiko ogochancha chitugo chiabo.
tgt_text: Unauthorized livestock movement spreads disease. Farmers should demand permits and follow quarantine notices.

src_text: Obonyenyi etugo obuya na gacha enyama buya protect. Tumia ebichinchio biria biancheire gose bwatia amachiko yobochenu ekero okonyenya etugo yao nka.
tgt_text: Proper slaughter methods protect meat safety. Only use licensed slaughterhouses or follow public health guidelines for home slaughter.

src_text: Ekero etugo yarire emete gete nigo ekoba esumu mebere yabo. Nere buya abaremi batogore emete buna eyio yonsi na koa chitugo chiabo obonyansi obuya chinaki chiguragura. Ogopima etugo yao nomonyagitari bwetugo nabio bikoenekia ayio.
tgt_text: Certain plants poison livestock. Farmers should remove toxic plants and provide alternative fodder during drought. Veterinary analysis supports diagnosis.

src_text: Eguragura nego eganitie emeroberio emeikernu korenda amache, gosiarera ebimeri amache, na koa etugo amache okonywa. Karwe amache echichuba, keania obonge bwetugo yao genkioy, na gacha amache.
tgt_text: Drought requires special management. Provide minerals, reduce herd size early, and conserve water.

src_text: Kogacha endagrera buya nigo egokonya ogotabosa kwendagera.
tgt_text: Proper feed storage prevents aflatoxin contamination. Keep grains dry, mold-free, and securely stored.

src_text: Korwa eripoti bwango igoro yamarwaire gochia ase abanyagitari nigo egotanga oborwaire kwambokerana/koranda. Manyia omonyagitari bwetugo rangeria esimi eye yamorero 0800721313 otari goakana kende.
tgt_text: Early reporting prevents outbreaks. Contact veterinary officers or the Toll-Free Animal Disease Hotline 0800721313.

src_text: Ogoonchoreria kwerire nigo gokogesa emechando ase atugo. Beka etugo yao inse yekiriri, emetaro yogosokia amache amachafu, chimbago gotanga embeo, na komanya bwango igoro yogoonchoreria kwerire bwebage.
tgt_text: Climate change increases animal risks. Provide shade, drainage, windbreaks, and use early warning systems.

src_text: Okogacha amere buya neganetie obochenu. Sibia enyeri nechimbere buya, beka amabere ase egento ekerabu, kendia amabere, na yaoneri bari bawete amarube yokobanchera koonia amabere boke.
tgt_text: Milk safety requires hygiene. Wash udders, use clean containers, cool milk, and sell only to licensed processors.

src_text: Okonganya korwa aa gochia aaria kwa abatugi nkoganetie emeroberio emiya. Nyora ogwancherwa gwokong'anya netugo yao, etera ase atari nemechando, kabe are korwa chingongo chiria chire neminano.
tgt_text: Pastoralist migrations need planning. Obtain permits, choose safe routes, and avoid conflict areas.

src_text: Amariko abwate maeleso yoboremi bwetugo yao nigo akogokonya ase emeroberio yao. Bwatia komanya chitariki chia kera etugo ekero yabiaretwe, ogokwa, buna kwarure obobwenia, na gochichancha.
tgt_text: Accurate records improve management. Track births, deaths, treatments, and vaccinations.

src_text: Oboibi bwemetana yechinchoke mbogendererete kogeseka. Renda buya emetana, yebeka chinamba, na manyia igoro yabagori bakengeka.
tgt_text: Beehive theft is rising. Secure apiaries, mark hives, and report suspicious buyers.

src_text: Obochafu bokorwa ase chifakitori nigo bokorentera etugo obokongu. Karwe eripoti igoro gotuguta obochafu bwabo ase enchera etari engiya, gita aase eubochafu bogotugutwa, na pima amche komanya gose nabwate ebinyinyi.
tgt_text: Industrial pollutants harm animals. Report dumping, fence off contaminated sites, and test water.

src_text: Omogoko omonene nigo ogoita etugo na okoranda kwendwarim yetugo. Siarera obweri eriogo motwe yemegoko.
tgt_text: Floods kill animals and spread disease. Move herds to higher ground and disinfect pens after floods.

src_text: Oborendi bwebinyoro nogo bogokeania oboibi bwetugo. Karwe amanagana obotuki na bwatisia porisi kobeka oborendi.
tgt_text: Community policing reduces livestock theft. Share intelligence and support police investigations.

src_text: Kogacha na gotumia bobe obwoyo buya nigo kogokeania amarwaire. Karwe ribaga risaine ase eubo koguna na goonchoreria koba obwoyo omanye kobotumia na bobeke are korwa ase amache.
tgt_text: Proper manure handling prevents disease. Compost before use and store away from water sources.

src_text: Chingiti chingenda nse nkorasa chire etugo aaria chingongo chinyomo. Rabia orsana na rigia obowenia bwa bwango ase etugo yao rasirwe neng'iti engenda nse.
tgt_text: Snakes bite animals in dry seasons. Clear bushes and seek immediate treatment for bites.

src_text: Ase ebinto bigoakerwa omonada nigo akongusa ebibago. Akera omonada aase aitabire neserikari, rigereria buya abagori baino, na gacha buya amariko buna ogoaka omonada ebinto ebio.
tgt_text: Auction yards attract criminals. Use licensed yards, verify buyers, and maintain registers.

src_text: Ebibaki na makotu nigo akira ebichichu buna endagera yabo. Gitera etugoyao buya na rosia ebinto binga buna omonto obogoretie enyimbo gochia igoro na koyeka aroro kogosa ebinto ebio bitgete koira etugo.
tgt_text: Large birds prey on young livestock. Use scare devices and provide sheltered pens.

src_text: Kweroberia buya nyuma yemechando nigo ogotanga asara. Orokia chinchera chiokominchoreria ekero kiemebasekano na gacha endagera orarie ekero kiemebasekano.
tgt_text: Disaster preparedness reduces losses. Identify evacuation routes and store emergency supplies.

src_text: Ase amache akobucherwa nigo akongusa ebibago. Ira chiombe kere mobaso konywa amache animals no mokera buya aase okagerete abaibi barabaise korwera.
tgt_text: Water points attract thieves. Water animals by day and patrol high-risk areas.

src_text: Okwana gwechiombe nigo gokogechia abanto. Koagacha obweri obuya nigo bogotanga eriogi riokwana na igo gotanga abanto kwemurangania.
tgt_text: Animal noise disturbs communities. Proper housing reduces noise and prevents complaints.

src_text: Etugo yabagoire nigo egosari ebimeri biabanto. Gitera buya etugo yao na manyia abanyene ekero etugo yao yasaririe ebinto bia bande.
tgt_text: Stray animals destroy property. Maintain secure fencing and report damage promptly.

src_text: Omorero chingaki chieguragura nigo okorenta obokongu ase oborisia bwetugo. Onye omogondo bwendagera gose rinani ore omonene, yobarore gati gati na koyatiga atri namete gose obonyansi gotanga omorere gotamboka gochia asande na manyia abarai onye nomonto bwogetie obomorero eyio makusudi.
tgt_text: Dry season fires threaten grazing areas. Create firebreaks and report arson incidents.

src_text: Renda korora nga ekero etugo yao ekobwata embego yakorirwe ase enchera engiya etarikoumisa etugo eria ekobwata embego. Tumia eeri ebwate afia engiya , renda obochenu, na rika inse chitariki kwaete etugo yao embego.
tgt_text: Proper breeding management prevents injuries. Use healthy stock, maintain hygiene, and record breeding dates.

src_text: Oboibi bwebinto bioboremi buna chitinga chiokorem nebinde nigo bikoirania magega gose gokei rigesa. Gacha buya ebinto biao biogokora oboremi buya na manyia abagambi igoro yoboibi biebinto biao bioboremi bwngo.
tgt_text: Equipment theft affects productivity. Secure tools and machinery and report theft immediately.

src_text: Enkoba nigo egoita etugo ere getii korisia. Beka ebinto biria bikobwata enkoba na tiga gosiba etugo ase omote ore oymo.
tgt_text: Lightning kills grazing animals. Install lightning rods and avoid tying animals to isolated trees.

src_text: Ekero amariogo aria agotanga ebinyinyi komenta omobere ime agotumeka bobe, nigo akoa ebinyinyi chinguru goika eriogo riasinywa gokora egasi yobobwenia buya. Bwatia amereso omonyagitari buya na tuguta amariogo ase enchera engiya buna eyokoyatindeka.
tgt_text: Misuse of antibiotics creates resistance. Follow prescriptions and dispose of drugs safely.

src_text: Rosia na kogacha endagera yetugo yao genkio gotanyorwa nobokongu abwo motwe. Gacha endagera yetugo yao buya na simeka endagera yetugo eria ekoremereria omogaso omonene.
tgt_text: Plan feed supplies to avoid shortages. Preserve fodder and use drought-resistant varieties.

src_text: Ekero etugo ekoirwa ase enchera etari engiya nigo ekoba nobwoba, ogochandeka ebirengererio an koumia. Beka etugo aase atari noboterere na yesibe buya.
tgt_text: Poor handling causes stress and injury. Use non-slip floors and proper restraint equipment.

src_text: Esitima etbikirie buya nabo are hatari ase etugo. Rora gose chigwaya nchiererete inse na gopima gose nchire nomorero kera engaki erio korenda etugo teakwa nesisitima.
tgt_text: Faulty electrical systems harm animals. Inspect wiring and test for stray voltage regularly.

src_text: Koira etugo rooche konya amache aase are egetionko nabo etugo aranyare gotereria na kogwa amache ime ekwe. Rosia buya aase etugo yao ekonywera amache na gita aase are atari ase etugo.
tgt_text: Steep water edges trap animals. Install gentle slopes and fence dangerous areas.

src_text: Aaria ase oboremi bogokorerwa amasomo ogotema ao ao naganetie oborendi obuya. Tumia ebimoreki biria biekamera bikobwata buna abanto bagosoa nagosoka, renda nga tari kera omonto ogosoa aroro, nobomongeri obuya.
tgt_text: Research farms need strict security. Use CCTV, controlled access, and patrols.

src_text: Ekero riberera rire igoro mono nigo rigokei amabere ase etugo. Beka ekiriri, karwe ribaga ase embeo rgoetera, na beka amache okonya ase etugo chingaki chionsi.
tgt_text: High temperatures reduce productivity. Provide shade, ventilation, and constant water.

src_text: Komanya omochando bwango nigo kogotanga asara. Rigeria buya komanya rire buna rire na sanga nabatugi bamino.
tgt_text: Early warning prevents losses. Monitor conditions and share forecasts with herders.

src_text: Erende korwa omochieso ogotangaswa ase chisimi kobeka chibesa ase etimi gete ng'a nonyore chibesa goetra esimi chingaki chiegosri yomopira. Abange ba abwo bakorenta chigosori echi nigo barengete koiba amanga iigoro yao bakorere oboibi.
tgt_text: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud

src_text: Abanyanyimbo mbagendererete gotuka igoro yogochaka ogokonywa ase abasae neserikari ya Kenya goetera TikTok na Instagram. Gento kenga buna ekio tikeiyo korende noborimo bwoka.
tgt_text: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."

src_text: Abakenya abange banyorire chisimi korwa ebobagp bikobasaba chibesa gose kobaa amanga igoro yabo korwa abakweroka buna baria bagokora emeremo yobobogoria emesigo korwa chinse chia isiko mbare nomosigo oo abae chibesa chiogoetia omoesigo iyio erio bagokonye. Koranyore esimi yengencho etye manyia office chia chiebango (KRA) gose ekambani eyio bakogotebi.
tgt_text: Several Kenyans have reported scam calls claiming to be from international couriers requesting customs clearance payments. Confirm such calls with KRA or the courier directly

src_text: Renda kegima tosoa ase emeroberio yogosomia igoro goetera chisimi nabanto bare nokobua gokong'ina nakobebegena bagosaba chibesa chinyinge gosoera Abange babanto aba tiberigeti neserikari.
tgt_text: "Be cautious of business mentorship programs advertised by influencers that ask for hefty registration fees. Many lack legal registration."

src_text: Nigo togosaba abanto komanyia abagambi gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagosaba chibesa basuguikie akadi yao ya NHIF ekore egasi. NHIF teri gosaba besa goetia emesigo.
tgt_text: "We urge wananchi to report any person asking for 'expedited NHIF services' in exchange for cash. NHIF does not charge for processing."

src_text: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria ere abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.
tgt_text: "Ministry of Housing has not contracted any agents to collect payments for affordable housing units. Application is done through Boma Yangu portal only."

src_text: Ekeombe Ekebaririri gia Kenya kiarure ogokurerwa ase abanainchi igoro yemechango goetera MPESA chinamba chia till chitarikiri rasimi na Safaricom ase abwo bagosaba omochango . Tema komanya buya nyuma otatatoma chibesa chiao.
tgt_text: Red Cross Kenya cautions citizens against donation drives using MPESA till numbers not registered to the organization. Always crosscheck before sending money.

src_text: Ogokurera ase bonsi: Enseo yesrikari eria etenenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) teri gokria abanto ogotema gwokorigia emeremo goetra Whatsapp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported
tgt_text: Public warning: PSC does not conduct interviews on WhatsApp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported

src_text: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK ) nemanyete ebikoreri biechisimi apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. Ogosaba gochia baria batenenerete ogosaria kwobogoko (CRB) nigo kogokorwa nabanto bancheire gokora egasi eyio boka"
tgt_text: "CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only."

src_text: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) yarure ogokurerwa igoro yamarube oborimo koa abanto emeremo, gose chinamba chiamaremo chioborimo, na korenga oboremo obwo nga nirenga boisaine aaria Kisumu. Tumia chiofisi chieserikari ekero otagete komanya ayio boronge.
tgt_text: EACC has flagged a syndicate offering forged title searches and valuations in Kisumu. Use verified government channels only

src_text: "Omotuki omonene enekirie okobwatwa kwa abatenereri be'NGO boborimo bakweroka abakobwaterana nekeombe kia Omoroberio Bwendagera Bwense (World Food Programme) aaria Kenya ya Irianyi. Botambe manya boronge korwa egetabu gia NGO."
tgt_text: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."

src_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete okoererania amangana ase embeo kiarure ogokurera igoro yegokoreri gia bahati na sibu kioborimo kerandete ase Telegram. Abange nigo bakoiba amanga ao are ase esimi amo nayenamba yebengi yao.
tgt_text: Communications Authority warns of cloned betting apps circulating on Telegram. Many steal your phone data and banking information

src_text: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria kere baakani abango nga abaachenti babo tibaganeirie korusia ebango gose koegwa chibesa tbarabwo abanyene. Tumia enamba yabeene ya PayBill na nyora risiti riogoakana.
tgt_text: KRA reminds taxpayers that agents are not allowed to collect cash payments in person. Use official PayBill numbers and receipts

src_text: "Nigo togosaba abakenya komanya buya amatangaso yechigasi korwa ase ebitii bienchindege, mono kobua buna keria Emirates na Qatar. Amatangaso amange yoborimo igoro yemeremo ase ebitii biechindege bwaansire.
tgt_text: "We urge Kenyans to confirm job offers from airlines, especially Emirates and Qatar Airways. Multiple scams promising airport jobs have been flagged.

src_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwani obopkorekanu (EACC) ngotuka kere abanto gete bagwekora baria bakorigereria amatumisi yechibesa chieserikari na igo gosaba amaaki korwa ase chisukuru chinke. Okorigererigwa bwebitabu nigo gokoba ekero gwatangasirwe.
tgt_text: EACC is investigating individuals posing as ministry auditors soliciting bribes from small schools. All inspections are officially scheduled and documented

src_text: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere abanto ba Kenyan ng'a chibengi boronge tichiri gokinia abakori emeremo babo goetera Facebook. Ombia mang'ana ande onsi akogosaba obae ennamba yao yebengi erio bakobekere ekeegwa gie chibesa."
tgt_text: "CBK reminds Kenyans that legitimate banks do not conduct promotions via Facebook inboxes. Ignore messages asking for account details to 'activate rewards'."

src_text: "Omotuki omonene orure ogokurera gochia abangainereria baria bakkonia amaremo echikanisa ataiyo aari kayole na Ruai. Manya buya abanyene oboremo ase ofisi chia amaremo otaraakana besa chinde chionsi."
tgt_text: "DCI warns against conmen selling fake 'church land' in Kayole and Ruai. Verify ownership documents at the Ministry of Lands before making any payment."

src_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) giakureire abanto baye bonsi baombie amanga ande onsi korwa WhatsApp agotebia abanto ng'a baria bonsi baikire emiaka 40 nkonyarekana ere korusia chibesa chiabo. Mang'ana anga buna ayio taiyo.
tgt_text: NSSF alerts contributors to disregard WhatsApp messages claiming there is a special withdrawal window for those over 40. No such provision exists.

src_text: Erende korwa amatangaso yokonyora chibesa goetera chitimu chiomopira chikobua chigotangaswa ekero kiemepira egoakwa ase abarimo gagwesoi ime. Abange babwo nigo barengete komanya na koiba amangana yebinto biao bakoibere nonya nechibesa.
tgt_text: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud.

src_text: "EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.
tgt_text: "The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp

src_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) giakureire abakwebeka buna mbare namabaga ase yemeremo ase chikambani chiserikari ase okobaakana besa inke. Emeremo yonsi yeserikari nigo egotangaswa ase ensemo yeserikari tenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) na ase eintaneti yechikambani echio.
tgt_text: EACC warns of imposters offering job placements at parastatals for upfront cash. All official job listings are published on PSC and organization websites.

src_text: "Abanto batomeirwe amang'ana koiranigwa chibesa ase bare ase egsio ekebe korwa safaricom. 'Ogosabwa oko koirania chibesa nigo kogokorwa ase enchera omonto okonayra kwegena. Safaricom teri gosaba koiranigwa gwechibesa otaichoretie efomu yabeene."
tgt_text: "People have been sent 'Safaricom refund claim' links that look like the real site. Safaricom does not issue refunds without an official claim form."

src_text: Emonistiri yobobogoria yanyorire amang'ana igoro yabateneneri boborimo ba (NTSA) bagosaba amaaki ase chinhera chinene. Karwe amangana igoro yamang'ana anga buna ayio are nechitang'utang'u naro goetera enamba yesimi yamorero 999 gose eintaneti ya (NTSA)
tgt_text: The Ministry of Transport has received reports of fake NTSA agents collecting bribes along major highways. Report any suspicious activity via 999 or NTSA portal

src_text: Nigo togosemia abanto ba Kenya tibasanga chipicha chibibande chiabana babo, chiria chia nyagitari (NHIF ) gose chikadi chiogoaka chikura ase okorigia emeremo goetera Facebook. Amangana aya yabana bao nigo agotumika gokora obosaria.
tgt_text: We advise Kenyans not to share photos of their ID, NHIF or voters card on Facebook job groups. These details are being harvested for fraud

src_text: Ekeoombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) kiabutire abakori emeremo abange banyoretwe bagosangereria chibesa korwa abagotu erio kobakonya korosia chibesa chiobogotu bwabo. NSSF teri gosaba besa chinde chionsi ekero ekobwatia komanya ayakorengete.
tgt_text: NSSF has suspended several field agents found collecting cash for 'special processing. NSSF does not charge for fast-tracking services

src_text: Abana abange basisiririe chibesa chiesukuru fisi goetera chiakaonti chioborimo chibekire WhatsApp. Chingaki chionsi akana chibesa chiesukuru goetera ebengi yesukuru yekeene.
tgt_text: Several students have lost fees to fake school accounts shared on WhatsApp. Always pay school fees through officially designated bank accounts.

src_text: Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) yakureire abaKenya igoro yogotoma chibesa gochia chigurupu chiembeo bakobangaina konyora obwaita kera ewiki. Ebinto binga buna ebio tibiri bia amachiko igo nebiobong'ainereria.
tgt_text: CBK warns Kenyans against sending money to social media groups promising weekly payouts from investment plans. These are unregulated and illegal.

src_text: Abaonia bechinsuarensi boborimo babeire bakoonia ebinto bioborimo nonya nime yechirori chibasi. Manya buya ng'a einsuarensi yao nerikire gose neitabire neserikari goetera Insuaren Regulatory Authority (IRA).
tgt_text: Fake insurance brokers have been selling invalid motor covers in bus stations. Confirm your insurer through IRA public registry.

src_text: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list
tgt_text: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list

src_text: "Twanyorire chiripoti chinyinge chiabanto bagwegokora ng'a mbare namarube yemeremo gochia Qatar na UAE. Emeremo yonsi gochia chinse chia isiko goika aetere ebiombe bimanyekanete buya nabwo bagotebwa nga mbare nemeremo neserikari ya Kenya"
tgt_text: "We have received multiple reports of individuals faking job placement letters for Qatar and UAE. All foreign employment must go through accredited agencies."

src_text: "Chibicha chioborimo gotumia chibicha chiabanto bande baibete korigeria chibesa chiangirwe buna okogenda mamincha yerichiko ria twiter. Kera engaki chungusa abakorigia chibesa goetra chinchera chiegenire buna M-Changa gose Omosaraba Omobaririri) Red Cross Kenya."
tgt_text: "Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya."

src_text: Abamenyi ba Nairobi, kab maiso nabanto bagwekora ng'a nkorwa bare chironi chiebiasara ase engaki yensa eyemo yoka. Eserikari tebwati moroberio onga buna eyio bwechibesa koboko chiokorwa.
tgt_text: Nairobi residents, beware of people who claim to provide business loans within an hour. The government does not have such a cash-in-hand program.

src_text: Abakenya bakureirwe gwetanga koonia chibesa chiechinse ao ao goetera eintaneti abanyabiasara bakongaina abanto nga abaita obonene mboreo. Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) teri korwa erensesi as omonto oyomo gkora agasi eyio.
tgt_text: Kenyans are warned to avoid online forex traders promising guaranteed profits. CBK does not license individuals to offer such services.

src_text: Omotuki omonene okureire aanainchi igoro yamarube yogosa eyunifasiti yoborimo agendererete gotimeka kongaina na koibera abaibori. Kera engaki chungusa rirube riogosoa eyunifasiti goetra uyunifasiti enyene.
tgt_text: DCI cautions the public against forged university admission letters being used to defraud parents. Always verify admission directly with the institution.

src_text: "Ekeombe getenenerete oboererania bwamang'ana giaansire enamba ya morero gokonya koyemanyia gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagwekona nga nkorwa bare obokoreri beintaneti. Aka esimi 0800 222 777 koyemanyia amang'ana ayio."
tgt_text: "Communications Authority has launched a hotline for reporting impersonation scams involving fake mobile providers. Dial 0800 222 777 to report."

src_text: "Kabe maiso korwa abanto bagwekora ng'a nkorika bare ase omoroberio bweinsuarensi ya nyagitari (NHIF) abwo ase chirori chikorinerwa. Ripoti abanto abwo ase eporisi ere ange naye. Kwerika koba oyomo ase Einsuarensi ya Nyagitari (NHIF) mbosa egokorwa."
tgt_text: "Be cautious of agents offering NHIF registration at matatu stages. Report such individuals to the nearest police post. NHIF registration is free."

src_text: "Eminisitiri yechisemi yabekire chinguru nga chibasari chiesukuru nigo chikorugwa bosa fnaigo tegaineirie nga oakane. Gosabwa besa chinde chionsi nere buya korwaipoti."
tgt_text: "The Ministry of Education reiterates that bursary forms are distributed freely and do not require payment. Any demand for money should be reported."

src_text: "Nigo togosaba abakenya koirorera gocheki oboamaene bwebiombe bia NGO dchigosaba ogokonya goetera entaneti. Chinyinge chiechio chianyorirwe koba echioboibi"
tgt_text: "We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud."

src_text: Tobaisa korwa epini ya M-PESA yaogochia ase onde bwensi! Eye nero enchera abange baibeirwe.
tgt_text: Do not give your M-PESA PIN to anyone! This is a very common scam.

src_text: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
tgt_text: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.

src_text: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
tgt_text: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.

src_text: Tumia enomba yesiri enkongu okoigorera esimi yao buna Gusii2025! Eyio etari raisi ase monto onde koigora.
tgt_text: Use a strong password like 'Nairobi2023!/' that is not easy to crack.

src_text: Tobaisa kobata eraini yeintaneti orechitangutangu nero buna eria ekogotebi ng'a kwanyorire chibesa 100,000!' goetera amangana ameng'e eyesimi.
tgt_text: Never click on suspicious links like 'Youve won KSh 100,000!' in SMS.

src_text: Kera engaki tema gokora keboyia einchini yesimi yao kera omotienyi erio koyerenda korwa okoriegwa nebinyinyi.
tgt_text: Update your phones software monthly to fix security vulnerabilities.

src_text: Onye omwana oo ogochandwa, kogoswa gose koramwa goetera eintaneti, manyia omonene bwobotuki otari konyorwa!
tgt_text: If your child is being bullied online, report it to the DCI Cyber ​​Unit immediately!

src_text: Tiga gotumia chisimi gose eintaneti kobeka gose gotoma chibesa gochia akaonti yao yebengi. Gokora igo nigo okorwa ribaga abaibi bare nobang'aini bwogosoa eintaneti yao na gokoibera ase obowororo.
tgt_text: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Hackers can steal your data.

src_text: Risegereria komanya inki 'Serena_254's' erengete nyuma otarakora kende nabarabwo.
tgt_text: Check 'Serena_254's' profile to see if it's legit before accepting the friend request.

src_text: Tumia chinamba chiesiri ekero ogosoa ase Wi-Fi yabanto bonsi erio bwerende korwa abant barengete koyetuka komanya ninki kere ime.
tgt_text: Use a VPN on public networks to encrypt your internet traffic.

src_text: Sieka ESIM kadi yesimi yao buna *gentogete#! Totigera omonto atumie eraini yesimi yao gokora obobe
tgt_text: Lock SIM yako kwa *something#! Usiache mtu atumie line yako kufanya maovu.

src_text: Mongera buna chibesa chia chigosoa na gosoka kera ewiki ase akaonti yebengi yao erio onyare komanya bwango boibi bonde bwonsi bobaise kobao.
tgt_text: Monitor bank statements for unauthorized transactions weekly.

src_text: Tumia egento buna ekiara kiao gose epicha yobosio bwao rika ria enamba yesiri ase ekonyarekana.
tgt_text: Use biometrics (fingerprint/face ID) instead of PINs where possible.

src_text: Ombia amang'ana ameng'e esimi buna 'Kwabuire ejakipoti ya Safaricom' Aya namangana arengete gokoibera.
tgt_text: Ignore messages like 'Youve won Safaricom Jackpot!'Theyre scams.

src_text: Amanagana ao obobisi yakeborane gochia enkwana yobobisi otayarasanga ase eintaneti.
tgt_text: Encrypt sensitive files before sharing them online.

src_text: Totumia enamba yesiri eyemo ase esimi, ebengi, akaonti ya Gmail, sose Facebook! Omonto aise gwesoi ase akaonti yao, onso aria kwabwate aroro nigo agosira pi na tokoyanyora rinde.
tgt_text: Don't use the same password for Gmail, Facebook, and bank! If hacked, they'll all be gone.

src_text: Kongoria buya ebiombe biria bigosaba ogokonywa goetera eintaneti otararwa besa ende yonsi. Abarigia chibesa boborimo nao bare.
tgt_text: Verify charities before donating online.Fake fundraisers are common.

src_text: Beka egento keria kegotanga ebinyinyi ase esimi nekombiuta yao koyerenda korwa ebinyinyi bia malware na spyware.
tgt_text: Install antivirus software to protect against malware and spyware.

src_text: Tiga kongaineka ng'a notenke bwango' emeroberio amangana akogotebia obwaita bwa bwango. Obo noborimo.
tgt_text: Avoid 'get rich quick' schemes promising high returns.Theyre Ponzi scams.

src_text: tanga abanto korwa eWi-Fi yao ya nka goetera ringana rikingu kwegia buna'Jamhuri@1963'.
tgt_text: Secure home Wi-Fi with a strong password like 'Jamhuri@1963'.

src_text: Rimia eBluetooth yao ekero otari koyetumia. Abanto bande bensemo nabo barosoe ase esimi yao otamanyanyeti.
tgt_text: Turn off your Bluetooth when you're not using it! Others can access your phone.

src_text: Rigereria 'https://' amo nekeogorero kiaye nyuma otarabeka gose goskana chisebesa goetera eintaneti.
tgt_text: Check for 'https://' and a padlock icon before entering payment details online.

src_text: Tumia ekerore ase ekombiuta yao yakoboko ekerore monto onde ore ange naye atanyarekorora eki okorikagose gwancha monto abekerere gento igoro ase ekombiuta yao. Eyio nabe arabe enchera eyemo yomoiba amangana ao gose kokoibera chibesa.
tgt_text: Use privacy screens on laptops in public to prevent shoulder surfing.

src_text: Tobaisa gotumia erieta riorera ria mama omino buna ring'ana ria riobobisi bwesimi gose ekombiuta. Tumia erieta riokwebaka orayare koinyora.
tgt_text: Don't use 'Mothers maiden name' for security questions! Use a fictional answer.

src_text: Amanagana agokomanyia igoro yemesigo yoborimo goetera DHL nenchera eyemo abanto bakongainwa. Rigia komanya buya emeremo ekambani eyio egokora.
tgt_text: Fake DHL parcel alerts are common scams.Verify via official customer service.

src_text: Tobaise koigora gose kobeka chisiinema chia bosa ase ekombiuta yao goetera egento keria gekogacha chisinema gekorokwa eflash! Nabo keeranyare gosaria ekombiuta yao goetera ebinyinyi eflash ebogoretie.
tgt_text: Do not open the 'Free Movies' USB on your computer! It may contain a virus.

src_text: Ekero ogotumia ekombiuta yeintaneti, yebeke tabaisa kogacha eki kware korora gose gosoma ekero gwasiekire eki kware gokora. Renda gotagacha eki ogokora ase ase ekombiuta.
tgt_text: Use incognito mode on shared devices to avoid saving browsing history.

src_text: Onye gokorigia ogokonywa korwa ekambani, tumia chinamba chiesimi gose eintaneti yekambani.
tgt_text: If you are looking for customer support, use the numbers on the company's website.

src_text: Tobaise gwanchera ekombiuta okogachere ringangana riao riobobisi koyeigora erio korenda amagnana ase ekonbiuta eise koibwa gose gosira.
tgt_text: Disable browser password-saving features to protect accounts if your device is stolen.

src_text: Tarera chinyomba chigokomboa aye omonyene. Amangana goetera eintaneti nabo arabe oborimo.
tgt_text: Visit rental properties in person. Online listings can be fake.

src_text: Nyora ebinto biria bigokonya esimi gose ekombiuta gokora emeremo korwa aase egenire buna Google Play gose Apple App Store.
tgt_text: Download apps only from official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store.

src_text: Tumia egento kegotanga amangana ogotangasa ebiasara buan kwanyorire esimi iPhone eye nencher eyemo yogotanga ebinyibigosaria esimi giose ekombiuta yao.
tgt_text: Use ad blockers to stop malicious pop-ups like 'Youve won an iPhone!'.

src_text: Rora buya ng'a ningo otomete eimeil komanya eyebingainereria buna 'support@paypa1.com' (Oboibi!).
tgt_text: Check email sender addresses for typos like 'support@paypa1.com' (scam!).

src_text: "Tiga korusia ebikoreri biria bigonya esimi gokora egasi korwa eintaneti aende yonsi. Kera engaki binyore korwa Google Play Store gose Apple App Store".
tgt_text: "Do not download apps from random websites. Always use Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Unverified apps may contain malware."

src_text: "Erende korwa eWi-Fi yabanto bonsi kobeka chibesa ebengi. Tumia a VPN onye gokonyara gosoa ime. Chinetewaki chinyinge chia bosaare nchibwati borendi buya."
tgt_text: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Use a VPN if you must connect. Most free networks are not secure."

src_text: Tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya MPESA nonde bwensi. Safaricom gose ebengi mbarikobori koboria nga obayetebie. Ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio, rangeria ebengi yao koboria buya okonywe.
tgt_text: Do not share your MPESA PIN with anyone. Safaricom and banks will never ask for it. If in doubt, call official support.

src_text: "Eroserie 2FA (Chinchera ibera komnya buya) buna chiakaonti chiao ebengi chigendererete. Onye ringana riao riobobisi riaibirwe, nobe kwerendete ekiagera orosetie 2FA."
tgt_text: "Set up 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) for all your accounts. If your password is stolen, you will still be protected."

src_text: Kera engaki beka ehofia eri egokorende ekero kiomobasekano korinete epigipigi - ngokonya ere obogima!
tgt_text: Always wear a helmet when riding a bodaboda - it saves lives!

src_text: Tiga gotara kogotumia esimi ekero ore epara! Rigereria rigoro na maata otarantamboka.
tgt_text: Don't use your phone while walking on the road! Look both ways before crossing the road.

src_text: Beka abana are korwa ase omorero ore gose ebinto bigosamba aaria echikoni.
tgt_text: Keep children away from open flames and hot surfaces in the kitchen.

src_text: Sambereria gose beka ase emerangwa nechitirisa ase enyoba yeekorofa ebinto bigokonya gotanga abana tibagwa inse.
tgt_text: Install barriers on windows and doors on upper floors to prevent children from falling.

src_text: Tobaisa gotiga abana boka aase amache amange are - okonywa chintobe nigo ekoba raisi otamanyeti.
tgt_text: Never leave children unattended near water bodies - drowning happens silently.

src_text: Tumia gotamboka epara aase ebimanyererio bibekire gose chitochi chikogotebia ekero obwenerete gotamboka epara.
tgt_text: Use crossing points and traffic lights where available.

src_text: Beka ebinto biria bikonyonka erioki ase enyomba yao gokomanyia bwango elero enyomba yabwatire omorero oyorimie bwango.
tgt_text: Install smoke detectors in your home for early fire warnings.

src_text: Kabe namariogo nyomba aria aragokonye gokonyera oborwaire bwa mobasekano gose omonto oumiire otaramoikia nyagitari.
tgt_text: Keep a first aid kit at home and learn basic first aid procedures.

src_text: Kera engaki mongera chitariki chiendagera kogunda otaragora erio bwerende gotara na koria endagera eng'undo ekoretere obokong'u.
tgt_text: Always check expiry dates on food products to avoid food poisoning.

src_text: Korarore omorande bwesitima ogwete inse, toika ang,e rangeria enamba ya morero ya porisi 999 otari konyorwa.
tgt_text: If you see a power cable fallen, stay away and call 999 immediately.

src_text: Torerania ebinto buna eborogo gose chimesa chidito nyomba ase chinyasi gokonya hitichigwera abana ekero bagotema korina igoro.
tgt_text: Secure heavy furniture to walls to prevent tip-over accidents with children.

src_text: Tiga gotumia eagsi gotugera nyombe ase etirisa gose morangwa otari koreta embeo nyomba - yetumie ase aigogete embeo egosoa buya.
tgt_text: Do not use gas stoves indoors - keep them in a well-ventilated area.

src_text: Egegera buna oranyare goaka ontimbu -nabo eragokonye gose gokonya omonto onde.
tgt_text: Learn basic swimming skills - it could save your life or someone else's.

src_text: Egeria abana komanya amarieta abo onsi, enamba yesimi, inka sobo buna ekorokwa, agose enamba yeposita yerirube.
tgt_text: Teach children their full names, parents' contacts, and home address.

src_text: Manyia gose orokereria buya aase abanto bakominchoreria gochia ekero kiobokongu na koyatiga aigoire chingaki chionsi egasi egenderete.
tgt_text: Keep emergency exits open and unblocked in shops and offices.

src_text: Tiga gotumba ebinto ebinge ase esoketi eyemo yesitima -eye nabo erabe enchera eyemo yomorero gwateka nyomba.
